livingCosts.summary: The University of Sydney's own monthly budget for accommodation, food, transport, phone, lifestyle and gym over 12 months, using the low end of each of its ranges; the page itself says a single student needs at least A$2,042 a month.
livingCosts.notes: University of Sydney 'General living costs' table (monthly AUD, figures from the Study Australia cost-of-living calculator; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), low end of each range (midpoints until 2026-10-14). Housing: accommodation $980-$3,500. Food: food and groceries $1,000-$2,500. Transport: $130-$800. Personal: mobile phone $30-$100 + lifestyle $350-$650 + gym $70-$100. The page also cites the older Home Affairs visa minimum of $24,505/yr. Second look 2026-10-14: the page https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/fees-and-loans/other-costs/living-costs.html was re-read on 2026-10-14 (curl, HTTP 200; the 'General living costs' table is unchanged). The range midpoints summed to A$5,105 a month (A$61,260 a year), two and a half times the page's own headline ('a single student living away from home will require at least $2,042 per month for accommodation, food, utilities and entertainment', from the A$24,505-a-year Home Affairs figure it quotes), so each line now uses the low end of the university's range: accommodation 980, food and groceries 1,000, transport 130, personal = mobile phone 30 + lifestyle 350 + gym 70 = 450; total A$2,560 a month = A$30,720 a year, the closest itemisation of the page to its headline (no itemised row goes below these). OSHC is a visa cost and is excluded. The scraper targets for this page in scrapers/registry.yaml capture the low end of each range (changed 2026-10-14), matching this basis. Fix 2026-10-15: the opening sentence said 'range midpoints' and the maintainer note said the scraper still used midpoints; both now say low ends, which is what the figures and the registry patterns use. Source: https://www.sydney.edu.au/study/fees-and-loans/other-costs/living-costs.html.

The 2026 guide's equivalent figure (A$97,000) equals the standalone MD course-page rate, as the current notes already say.
